name: No LED Holder
short_description: Just a plain LED through a hole
long_description: No LED holder or mounting hardware included. Choose this if you don't need an LED indicator or plan to install your own LED mounting solution.

name: No LED
short_description: I dont know why youd want that, but ok.
long_description: No LED indicator light included with your pedal. The enclosure will be prepared without any LED drilling or mounting provisions.

name: Standard LED Holder
short_description: Youre a basic bitch? Take this basic LED mounting bezel
long_description: Standard chrome or black plastic LED holder bezel. Provides a clean, professional mounting solution for 3mm or 5mm LEDs. Includes mounting hardware and necessary drilling.

name: Fancy LED Holder
long_description: Upgraded decorative LED holder with enhanced styling. Available in various finishes including chrome, gold, and colored options. Adds a premium touch to your pedal's appearance.

name: Fender Style Jewel
long_description: Classic Fender amplifier-style jewel indicator light. Features a domed lens that diffuses LED light beautifully. Available in various colors (red, amber, green, blue). Adds authentic vintage aesthetics to your build.

name: Illuminated Footswitch
short_description: You're all in for that high tech stuff, huh?
long_description: Footswitch with integrated LED illumination. The switch itself lights up when the pedal is active. Modern, clean look that eliminates the need for a separate indicator LED. Note: Requires specific footswitch wiring - please specify in order notes if you need wiring assistance.
